# Tierra Firme

> A consortium of three practitioners in commercial real estate, business and family capital, and intelligence research. Tierra Firme produces a free show, research and seminars for people placing capital across borders, starting with Latin America. Based in Bogotá, Colombia. Educational only: no listings, no brokered deals, no investment advice.

## Members
- Murphy D. Cheatham II, The Ground (commercial real estate): Private Clients Director at CBRE, Dallas, advising private families and high net worth individuals.
- Shawn Christopher Leamon, The Build (business and operations): founder and managing partner of LaGrande Global (since 2013) and founder and CEO of Cielo.Travel, Bogotá.
- Todd Allyn, The Research (intelligence research): Founding Director of Sovereo Intelligence Research (https://www.sovereo.com), former Dean of the College of Business at Chancellor University. Leads Tierra Firme research.

## Questions investors ask (sourced answers)
- [Can foreigners buy property in Colombia?](https://tierra-firme.pages.dev/questions/can-foreigners-buy-property-in-colombia): Yes, with the same ownership rights as Colombians, if the money comes in through the formal exchange market and is registered.
- [Why do you have to register a foreign investment in Colombia?](https://tierra-firme.pages.dev/questions/register-foreign-investment-in-colombia): Registration with Banco de la República is what protects your right to move the money and the sale proceeds back out.
- [What taxes do foreigners pay on property in Colombia?](https://tierra-firme.pages.dev/questions/taxes-foreigners-pay-on-property-in-colombia): Closing costs when you buy, annual predial while you own, tax on rent, and 15% capital gains tax when you sell after two years.
- [How does the exchange rate change your return on property abroad?](https://tierra-firme.pages.dev/questions/how-the-exchange-rate-changes-your-real-estate-return): Your return is the local price change plus or minus the currency move. A strong local gain can disappear when converted home.
- [Can buying property in Colombia get you a visa?](https://tierra-firme.pages.dev/questions/colombia-investor-visa-through-real-estate): It can support an M investor visa if the property is worth at least 350 monthly minimum wages, in your name, and registered with the central bank.
- [What is propiedad horizontal in Colombia?](https://tierra-firme.pages.dev/questions/what-is-propiedad-horizontal-in-colombia): The legal regime for buildings and gated communities: you own your unit, share the common areas, and pay a mandatory administration fee.
- [What are currency, political and structural arbitrage?](https://tierra-firme.pages.dev/questions/currency-political-and-structural-arbitrage): Three reasons the same money can buy more abroad, and three matching risks that decide whether the gap is real.
- [How do you evaluate a country before investing there?](https://tierra-firme.pages.dev/questions/how-to-evaluate-a-country-before-investing): Information, evaluation, interpretation, then action: gather sourced facts, test them, read what they mean for you, and only then commit.

## Notes
- Sovereo Intelligence Research provides research to Tierra Firme and takes no deal fees, advisory fees or carry.
- Nothing published by Tierra Firme is investment, tax or legal advice.
